title: Pk Project’s "My Love (First On Bass)" is a timeless groove bridging eras with funk and soul
htmlContent: When the Pk Project releases a new single, “My Love (First On Bass),” it is no exception. This track is a trip through music’s corridors of time, artfully mixing the lush, soulful sounds of the late ’70s with the kinetic spirit of the late-90s disco revival. “My Love (First On Bass)” pulls you in with a bassline that is deep, rich, and downright groove-laden. It’s the type of bass that doesn’t play nicely with the song but instead leads it, propelling the rhythm and refusing to let you stand still. The track is rooted in funk but twisted around RnB and hip-hop elements, and Pk Project has made something here that feels immediately nostalgic but is also entirely of the times. The cut is fantastic, with plenty of memorable hooks that you’ll find yourself singing all the way. The vocals are delivered with a silky yet knowing touch that captures the unrestrained spirit of disco without ever slipping into pastiche. Instead, they sound timeless, like they might have packed dance floors in 1979 or been the reason to throw a disco revival party in the ’90s. This clever tightrope walk makes “My Love (First On Bass)” appealing to vintage music enthusiasts as well as contemporary groove hounds. What remains most striking about this single is how organically it combines these genres. The groove is nestled around the funk influence and upbeat hip-hop that creates a timely hipster beat. The end result is a soundscape that seems rich and layered but accessible and catchy. https://open.spotify.com/track/7h9q3zhm5K7DhJbAIZUizB “My Love (First On Bass),” by Pk Project, is a master class in time and style travel without sacrificing any realness. It’s a feel-good track that dares you not to get lost in its infectious bounce and soulful melodies. Whether you’re the biggest funk fan or just looking for that new cool vibe with fat basslines, this song will become a house classic. “My Love (First On Bass)” is a sparkling chaos of a bass-propelled tribute to love, groove, and the timeless alchemy of disco and its inexhaustible spirit.
excerpt: Pk Project’s "My Love (First On Bass)" is a timeless track that seamlessly combines funk and soul, creating a groove that transcends generations.
